settings.landing.title: How work lands
settings.landing.body: What accepting a session's work does. Merge puts it into the repository's line, in its own checkout. Branch puts it on a new branch named by the pattern, from the session's branch, for you to push and open a pull request from — or for a plugin installed here to push and open it, where the rule names one. Daoris itself never pushes. A pattern can say `{quest}`, `{session}`, `{slug}` (the title's words) and `{repository}`.
settings.landing.byPlugin: Then plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens the pull request.
settings.landing.savedBranchPlugin: Accepted work in {{name}} is now put on a branch `{{pattern}}`, and plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens the pull request.
settings.landing.workspaceHint: The rule for each repository in this workspace that sets none of its own.
settings.landing.from.default: Merged into its line — the default.
settings.landing.from.repository.merge: Merged into its line, set for this repository.
settings.landing.from.repository.branch: On a branch `{{pattern}}`, set for this repository.
settings.landing.from.workspace.merge: Merged into its line, set for the workspace {{workspace}}.
settings.landing.from.workspace.branch: On a branch `{{pattern}}`, set for the workspace {{workspace}}.
settings.landing.autoAcceptSays: When a quest here is done, its work is put on its branch, and `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens a pull request without asking you each time. The pull request is where it is judged. Switch it off to accept each one yourself.
settings.landing.autoAcceptAlone: When a quest here is done, its work is put on its branch, and nothing leaves this machine: no plugin opens a pull request, so each done's branch waits here for you to push it. Switch it off to accept each one yourself.
settings.landing.byAuto: Accepted automatically when its quest is done.
settings.landing.savedBranch: Accepted work in {{name}} is now put on a branch `{{pattern}}` for you to push.
settings.landing.savedMerge: Accepted work in {{name}} is now merged into its line.
settings.landing.cleared: {{name}} takes how its work lands from what stands above it again.
